components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's optional courtesy title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When

          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional flat form, retained
            for backward compatibility: an owner may instead supply the
            structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields. On read this is the
            composed address — the normalized 'addressLine1' with the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended after a single space when present — or the
            normalized flat value when only the flat form was supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address (street
            number and name). Optional; when a non-blank value is supplied the
            structured fields are preferred over the flat 'address'. Normalized
            on create the same way as 'address' (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit,
            suite, etc.). Normalized on create the same way as 'addressLine1'
            and, when present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single
            space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            present. When supplied it must be four digits and, for a city whose
            region is known (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), must fall within that region's range; a city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit value. Stored and returned as
            given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the owner's ageBand against the
            registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'

          title: Shares household

            computed householdId (derived from lastName and postcode), so when
            another owner already shares the same lastName and postcode the
            create is normally rejected with 409; setting this to true
            acknowledges the shared household and allows the create to proceed
            as a declared household member (which is not flagged as a possible
            duplicate). Never persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false

                normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId.

                identityKey equals that of an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3a7f2c1b9d4e'
              readOnly: true

              title: Namesake count
              description: >-

                owner was created.

              title: Membership number
              description: >-

                where customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last
                two digits of the registrationDate's fiscal year (which starts on
                1 July), matching the owner's fiscalYear. Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, derived on read from the
                (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate on a fiscal year that
                starts on 1 July, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year (e.g. a registration date of 2026-08-16
                yields 'FY27').
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-

                and accumulate: 2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is
                0, 2 for a household of 3 or more members, and 3 when the owner's

                membershipPoints to a level: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points,
                3 for 4-5 points, and 4 for 6 or more points. Because a new owner
                has zero tenure, level 4 is reached only once the owner has entered

            timezone:

              description: >-

              example: 'Australia/Sydney'

            contactPreference:

## Summary

I implemented the `capacityWarning` feature: an owner's `capacityWarning` is returned `true` when their city already holds between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive) at create time — approaching but not reaching the hard limit of 50. The existing hard rejection at 50 (`CityAtCapacityException`, 409) is unchanged.

Changes:

- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — Added `assignCapacityWarning(owner)` to the create flow. It sets the flag `true` when `count >= 40 && count < 50`. Extracted the shared, case-insensitive per-city counting into a `countOwnersInCity(city)` helper now used by both the warning and the existing `rejectCityAtCapacity` hard check, keeping the two counts consistent.
- **`model/Owner.java`** — Added the `capacityWarning` field (mapped to `capacity_warning`) with getter/setter, so MapStruct maps it to the DTO by name (same pattern as `bulkSignupWarning`).
- **`openapi.yml`** — Added the read-only `capacityWarning` boolean to the `Owner` schema (regenerates `OwnerDto`).

The counting is taken over existing owners before the new one is persisted (matching `rejectCityAtCapacity` and the other warning rules), so a fresh city filled to 40 warns on the 41st create — exactly what the spec and `Cp54Tests` require.
